name: Krush

evidence.note: Band site promises three sets of rock, dance and more, and says to come party with the band.
Show list includes many nights at The Inn in Long Beach, plus weddings and beach bars.
Yearly Black Friday show at The Inn, Long Beach; tagged 70s, 80s, 90s rock.

dancing.notes: A party cover band. Its own site invites fans to party to three sets of rock and dance music, and it plays weddings.

description: A Long Island cover band playing rock and dance hits from the 70s to the 90s at bars, beach clubs and weddings, with regular shows at The Inn in Long Beach.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). The Oct 3 date at The Inn was not on the band calendar we read, but the band plays there often.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current description is still accurate, so no new description. Booking is through the contact form on the band site; the site does not show an email or phone in its text (an address only appears in hidden site settings, so not recorded). Several live photos on the band site carry a "Chris Nova Productions" watermark; those were skipped. YouTube channel is not linked from the band site but its name and Long Island description match.

logo.alt: Krush logo in curly white letters on black with the words Rock N Roll underneath

evidence.note: Band site lists 2026 shows at Long Island spots (Salt Shack, The Boatyard in Massapequa, The Inn in Long Beach, Dublin Deck in Patchogue, Daisy's Miller Place) and links the Facebook and Instagram pages.
About page describes Krush as a rock band that also plays weddings and private parties, and says it opened for Less Than Jake.
Mulcahy's in Wantagh lists "KRUSH - The Best of Rock" on Saturday, October 24, 2026.
YouTube channel "Krush The Band NY" describes a five-piece cover and original band based on Long Island.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: krushtheband.com, mulcahyslongisland.com, youtube.com.
